purpose: A fourth, independent re-reproduction of the restore drill, run by a fourth agent from a cold checkout of the same branch. Three prior drills already exist on the branch; this pass re-ran the measurement rather than treating those write-ups as sufficient, matching the task's own thesis that an unreproduced number is unverified.

environment.server_kind: unprivileged single-user cluster (initdb + pg_ctl, no root, no Docker), SCRAM auth, loopback only on 127.0.0.1:55432

dataset.description: Synthetic production-shaped dataset seeded through the aicc_app role after a full bootstrap + migrate + apply_table_grants provisioning pass (all 14 migrations applied, 55 relations incl. views), bulk-loaded with generate_series.

procedure.provisioning: command_center.db.roles.apply_bootstrap + command_center.db.migrations.upgrade (as aicc_migrator) + command_center.db.roles.apply_table_grants, called directly from a standalone scratch script rather than via the pytest fixtures, to exercise the same provisioning path a real recovery would use.
procedure.timed_window: target database creation (CREATE DATABASE) through the post-restore information_schema.tables count -- the wait an operator experiences during a real recovery. Excludes argument parsing and checksum verification, which precede the timer.

result.variance: 1-2s across 4 runs against one 2.3 MB backup archive; bash SECONDS has 1s granularity, so a 1s reading is a bucket-boundary effect rather than a real regression
result.conclusion: Confirms the order of magnitude of all three prior drills (2026-08-27: 2s flat; 2026-09-01: 2-3s; 2026-09-06: 3s flat) with a fourth, fully independent provisioning pass -- own initdb cluster, own role passwords, own seed script, side-by-side restore into a separate database. The restore step is real, reproducible, and supersedes the previously unverified ~5.4s figure cited in the SRV-07 design.

reproduction.seed_note: Seeded with a scratch script (not checked into the repository, same disposition as prior drills) bulk-inserting via generate_series through the aicc_app role, matching the row shape (task/session/run/run_event) used by tests/db/test_postgres_integration.py's _seed_run helper.
reproduction.harness_note: PostgreSQL provisioned without root or Docker access via a local initdb+pg_ctl cluster on a high port (this host has no docker.sock permission and no sudo). Same topology prior drills used through voyn-artifacts/.../pg_test_harness.sh.
steps: initdb + pg_ctl start an unprivileged cluster on 127.0.0.1:<high-port>
create a scratch database, create/ALTER the four product roles cluster-wide
seed task/session/run/run_event as aicc_app via generate_series bulk inserts
read elapsed_seconds from each --measure-out JSON; verify row counts in the restored DB

additional_verification: Also re-ran tests/db/test_postgres_integration.py and tests/db/test_backup_script_guards.py against the same harness (36 tests); all passed, including test_backup_restore_drill_round_trips_data, confirming the --measure-out artifact-writing code path still works end to end.
